title: Choose the Specimen Register layout
question: All three share the approved visual world and real sample content. Which composition should I build? You can also say what to combine or revise.

options.label: Open Register
options.thesis: The product index stays beside the selected record’s edit and document views.
options.viewport: A two-pane screen: searchable product rows at left, editable fields and nested MongoDB document stacked at right.
options.risk: The index is narrower, so fewer products fit across its columns.

options.label: Catalogue-First Spread
options.thesis: A broad product index lets both users scan before opening the selected record.
options.viewport: A full-width searchable index occupies the upper half; below it, the edit form sits beside the MongoDB document.
options.risk: The selected record begins lower on the page, so editing takes more vertical space.

options.label: Three-Panel Record Desk
options.thesis: Product browsing, editing, and document inspection each get a dedicated adjacent pane.
options.viewport: The product index, edit form, and nested MongoDB document appear as three parallel columns.
options.risk: All three panels become tighter, especially on small screens.
